name: Order Event Type 1 Code
definition: Events affecting the orders in financial instruments.

CAME.name: Cancelled At The Initiative Of The Member Or Participant Of The Trading Venue
CAME.definition: Member, participant or client decides upon its own initiative to cancel the order it has previously entered.

CAMO.name: Cancelled By Market Operations
CAMO.definition: Includes a protection mechanism provided for investment firms carrying out a market-making activity.

CHME.name: Change Of Status At The Initiative Of The Member Or Participant Of The Trading Venue

CHMO.name: Change Of Status Dueto Market Operations
CHMO.definition: Change of status due to market operations.

EXPI.name: Expired Order
EXPI.definition: Where the order is removed from the order book upon the end of its validity period.

FILL.name: Filled
FILL.definition: Where there is no more quantity to be executed.

NEWO.name: New Order
NEWO.definition: Receipt of a new order by the operator of the trading venue.

PARF.name: Partially Filled
PARF.definition: Where the order is not fully executed so that there remains a quantity to be executed.

REMA.name: Replaced By Market Operations Automatic
REMA.definition: Where any characteristic of an order is changed by the trading venue operator's IT systems. This includes where a peg order's or a trailing stop order's current characteristics are changed to reflect how the order is located within the order book.

REMO.name: Rejected Order
REMO.definition: Order received but rejected by the operator of the trading venue.

REMH.name: Replaced By Market Operations Human Intervention
REMH.definition: Where any characteristic of an order is changed by a trading venue operator's staff. This includes the situation where a member, participant of the trading venue has IT issues and needs its orders to be cancelled urgently.

REME.name: Replaced By The Member Or Participant Of The Trading Venue
REME.definition: Where a member, participant or client of the trading venue decides upon its own initiative to change any characteristic of the order it has previously entered into the order book.

TRIG.name: Triggered
TRIG.definition: Order which becomes executable or, as the case may be, non-executable upon the realisation of a pre-determined condition.

RFQS.name: Quote Request
RFQS.definition: Request for quote by one or more members or participants.

RFQR.name: Quote Response
RFQR.definition: Response to a request for quote submitted by one or more members or participants.
